fields.title: Output type
fields.description: The type to create can be selected. It can be either a Date, Time, Date&time (Local), or Date&time (Zoned).

fields.title: Start date
fields.description: The date at which the date&time creation should start, inclusive.

fields.title: Start time
fields.description: The time at which the date&time creation should start, inclusive.

fields.title: Start local date&time
fields.description: The local date&time at which the date&time creation should start, inclusive.

fields.title: Start zoned date&time
fields.description: The zoned date&time at which the date&time creation should start, inclusive.

fields.title: Use execution date & time
fields.description: If checked, the execution date & time will be used as starting point.

fields.title: Number of rows
fields.description: The number of rows to create.

fields.title: Interval between rows
fields.description: The interval between the created rows.

fields.title: End date
fields.description: The date at which the date&time creation should stop. The end date is inclusive, except if the output mode is 'Number and Duration' and the provided interval does not divide evenly between the start and end date.

fields.title: End time
fields.description: The time at which the date&time creation should stop. The end time is inclusive, except if the output mode is 'Number and Duration' and the provided interval does not divide evenly between the start and end time.

fields.title: End local date&time
fields.description: The local date&time at which the date&time creation should stop. The end date&time is inclusive, except if the output mode is 'Number and Duration' and the provided interval does not divide evenly between the start and end date&time.

fields.title: End zoned date&time
fields.description: The zoned date&time at which the date&time creation should stop. The end date&time is inclusive, except if the output mode is 'Number and Duration' and the provided interval does not divide evenly between the start and end date&time.

fields.title: Use execution date & time
fields.description: If checked, the execution date & time will be used as ending point.

fields.title: Output column name
fields.description: The name of the output column.
